20.description: City Council appointed 13 members to the Municipal Heritage Advisory Committee, with terms extending to the end of 2027 for some.

chips.text: Stevie Horn declined chair nomination due to a scheduling conflict.
Seven public members and representatives from six organizations were appointed.

21.description: The Municipal Heritage Advisory Committee appointed Brenda Southam as Chair and Michelle Loi as Vice-Chair for 2026, establishing its leadership for the upcoming year.

chips.text: Brenda Southam and Michelle Loi were appointed Chair and Vice-Chair of the committee.

7.description: The Heritage Conservation Program Committee approved its 2026 work plan, prioritizing activities despite unsuccessful funding for the full strategy.

chips.text: The heritage strategy does not cover intangible heritage.
Administration was directed to review the committee's work plan.
How to align committee work with the new heritage strategy remains open.
Administration will report on heritage strategy priorities in coming months.

22.description: The City's Advisory Committee will review its subcommittees and appoint members for 2026 to continue work on heritage awards, policy, and awareness.

chips.text: Heritage subcommittees support partners who tell Saskatoon's story.

10.description: A committee will allocate its 2026 budget of $17,900 for conferences, events, and memberships, after reviewing 2025 actuals.

24.description: The item provides updates on a proposed rezoning at 702-706 Victoria Avenue in Nutana, adjacent to a heritage property, and a public hearing for the St. John's Anglican Cathedral bylaw amendment.

chips.text: Proposed six-story building affects Nutana residents.

14.description: The committee recommends City Council receive updates from three subcommittees on matters they were asked to report on.
